items.quote: Bitte sagen Sie uns binnen 12 Arbeitstagen ab dem Datum dieses Briefes zu oder ab.
items.computation: The letter itself fixes the start of the period as its own date: 'ab dem Datum dieses Briefes' = 19.11.2026 (Thursday). This triggering day is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), so counting starts on 20.11.2026. The letter defines 'Arbeitstage' as Monday-Friday with holidays excluded, matching the standard German definition; no NW public holidays fall in the relevant window. Counting the 12 qualifying weekdays: 20.11 (Fri)=1, 23.11 (Mon)=2, 24.11 (Tue)=3, 25.11 (Wed)=4, 26.11 (Thu)=5, 27.11 (Fri)=6, 30.11 (Mon)=7, 01.12 (Tue)=8, 02.12 (Wed)=9, 03.12 (Thu)=10, 04.12 (Fri)=11, 07.12 (Mon)=12. The 12th working day is Monday, 07.12.2026, which is itself a working day, so no weekend/holiday-end adjustment is needed.
